text:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: API gateway 5xx spike for hosted inference (p50 latency ~1200ms, 5xx rate 7.8%). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd123/api-gateway

sre-alex: I'm seeing a ton of Redis slowlog entries and blocked clients on redis-cluster-prod-2. Starting triage.

eng-ryan: any recent deploys or config changes? We changed model-cache TTL to 1h in the last rollout. Could be churn.

infra-jin: No infra deploys on the Redis side. I'll SSH into the redis pods and check metrics (blocked_clients, connected_clients, evicted_keys).

eng-ryan: quick look at metrics: eviction spikes right after TTL change -> likely cache stampede. Many misses -> origin load rises -> retries/timeouts cascade -> gateway 502/504.

support-maya: several customers are opening tickets complaining about intermittent 502s and timeouts. Escalating to enterprise SRE list.

oncall-li: Triage plan: 1) temporarily bypass cache for hot prefix `model-cache:` (force origin hit) 2) scale Redis (add replica/primaries) and increase maxclients 3) enable gateway circuit-breaker to return graceful error or fallback to smaller model variant.

infra-jin: I'll push a quick gateway rule to mark requests with header `X-Cache-Bypass: true` for keys with prefix `model-cache:` so clients hit the runtime directly while we stabilize.

deploy-bot: Release v2026.03.17-cache-bypass applied to gateway config -> rolling update started.

monitoring-bot: Gateway rule deployed. We see 5xx rate starting to drop but overall p50 latency increased due to origin load.

sre-alex: Redis slowlog shows repeated long-running GETs and blocked clients. I'm going to restart redis-cluster-prod-2 master pod (planned quick restart) and bump `maxclients`.

infra-jin: Restart completed. Cluster slots rebalanced. Memory pressure still high; eviction policy was `allkeys-lru`. Changed to `volatile-lru` for now to avoid evicting critical persistent keys.

eng-ryan: We should instrument a singleflight cache fill on the model-cache keys and add jitter to TTLs to avoid synchronized expirations. Opened PR #4526 with proposed changes.

product-lena: I'll draft a short customer update explaining the mitigation (cache bypass + redis node restart) and estimated full recovery timeline.

support-maya: Sent customer notifications to impacted accounts: "We are bypassing cache and working on Redis recovery. No data loss expected, you may see higher latencies for short period." :thumbsup:

monitoring-bot: RESOLVED: 5xx rate back to baseline (0.6%). Keeping cache-bypass active for 30min for observation. Incident ticket created: INF-2026-101.

oncall-li: Postmortem to be scheduled. Preliminary root cause: TTL change triggered cache churn leading to stampede; Redis CPU & connection backlog caused timeouts -> gateway returned 5xx. Remediation: add cache singleflight, jitter TTLs, increase redis connection pool, circuit-breaker on gateway, and automated health checks for cache clients.

sre-alex: Adding follow-ups: add runbook steps for cache-bypass, playbook for redis restart and safe eviction policy, and a test plan to simulate TTL churn.

support-maya: Thanks team — I'll keep customers updated until final postmortem posted.
